measurementLimits: File inventory only; decoded memory assumes RGBA8 plus full mip chain (4/3). Not measured residency, draw calls, transfer, or FPS. Manifest referenced IDs omit recipe-driven and retained runtime selections.

source.notes: Authored tileable dressed-limestone flagstone laid in courses. Replaces a Poly Haven source whose albedo carried almost no structure (p5-p95 range 0.166, saturation 0.053), which made every court using it render as a flat pale sheet.

performanceAllocation.interpretation: Conservative simultaneous-visibility planning allocation. Roof static batching is required. Retained allowance covers existing gameplay props, actors, weapons and effects; actual game measurements remain mandatory.

roofRenderingContract.requiredImplementation: After loading only the installed BZ04 roof bundles, bake their transforms and merge static roof geometry by exact material/attribute signature and shadow class in buildAuthoredPlacements. Reuse the existing Three BufferGeometryUtils mergeGeometries dependency. Keep per-bundle bounds and contributor IDs for diagnostics. Do not batch untagged legacy props or change colliders. Without this batching, the post-batch draw allocation is not met.
roofRenderingContract.dependencyResolution: Resolve each named roof bundle directly; an installation output-unit name does not recursively authorize its whole area or that area dependency queue.
roofRenderingContract.retirementRule: Bundle placement upsert and successful model load precede the bounded render-only component retirement listed in roof-coordination.json.
